dedupe_keys.name: national liquid fuel facilities refineries terminals depots and petrol stations of australia geoscience australia

description: The National Liquid Fuel Facilities datasets give the locations of all known liquid fuel refineries, terminals, depots and petrol stations in Australia, with feature attributes. The Geoscience Australia catalogue record for the web service says it has provided these layers since 2016, and the ArcGIS MapServer lists four layers (Liquid_Fuel_Refineries, Liquid_Fuel_Terminals, Liquid_Fuel_Depots and Petrol_Stations), with WMS and WFS versions, released under CC BY 4.0 by the Commonwealth of Australia, free to use online or through the service interfaces. The 2012 National Liquid Fuel Refineries Database (DOI 10.4225/25/543b52337a516, by L. Carter and R. Kay) that turned up in the search is the refinery layer's earlier release; its old catalogue page no longer resolves. Coverage is Australia. Caveats: the catalogue metadata dates from 2016 to 2023, so closures since then may lag, and capacity attributes are not stated on the pages read. For simulation it gives the national fuel supply chain points, from refinery to terminal to depot and station, to model fuel shortages after port closures, floods or cyclones. Related catalogue records include the Australian operating mines map and the global refinery infrastructure data.
